string.text: Signs before the hunt, the Mark and Targeted Ground. Off: none of them, hunts come as before. Default on.
Game hours between the intercepted chatter on your PDA and the hunt: the hunt waits until they have passed. The same on every difficulty. 0: no signs. Default 1.
How much the Mark grows when you kill a boss (the boss, the emission boss or a Legend), of 100. Your shot or your assist counts. Default 20.
How much the Mark grows when you kill a named hunter, of 100. The hunters remember what you did to them. Default 10.
How much the Mark grows when you kill a regular member of a hunt squad, of 100. Other stalkers add nothing. Default 2.
How much the Mark grows when your hits make a named hunter break off: he saw your face. Default 8.
How much sooner the next hunt comes at a full Mark: Time between hunts is shortened by this share of it (less at a weaker Mark). With Targeted Ground, never more than half. Default 30.
Game hours for a full Mark to fade away by itself. 0: it never fades by itself. Default 48.
How much of the Mark a sleep takes away. Default 50.
How much of the Mark an anti-psy item takes away (Psy-Block, and every item that protects from psy). Default 35.
How much a map's targeting grows with every hunt fought on it, whatever its end, of 100. Default 15.
How much the map's targeting grows when your hits make a named hunter break off there: he tells them where you are. Default 10.
How much the targeting of the map you are on grows every Targeting stay hours. Default 10.
Game hours on one map for its targeting to grow by Targeting per stay. Default 12.
How many times faster a map cools on its own while you are elsewhere than it grows while you stay: staying is punished, exploring is rewarded. Default 3.
How much every map's targeting drops when you travel to another map: you shake their trail. Default 20.
How much the targeting of the map you are on drops when you use an anti-psy item: they lose you in their minds. Default 30.
How much sooner hunts come on a fully targeted map: Time between hunts is shortened by this share of it. With the Mark, never more than half. Default 25.
On a fully targeted map the hunters know your remembered spots from this much further away (the radius grows by this share). Default 100.
